post.description:
Run one Turn, streaming its AgentEvents as Server-Sent Events: the event name is the
event's type, the data its JSON. The stream ends after `done`. Closing it cancels the
Turn. 409 while the Thread has a Turn running; 503 when no model key is configured.

200.description: The Turn's AgentEvents, one per Server-Sent Event.

post.description: Cancel the Thread's Turn in progress: its stream ends with `done`, `cancelled`.

get.description:
Every Thread's tokens and estimated cost in one calendar month. `cost_usd` is null
when any request's cost is unknown.

Capability.title: Capability
Capability.description:
What an adapter can do on a Connection. The agent gets a tool only for capabilities the
Connection has.

Connection.title: Connection
Connection.description: A configured target: exactly one database. Holds a reference to the DSN, never the DSN.

ConnectionIn.title: ConnectionIn
ConnectionIn.description:
A Connection to add, or to update by name. The DSN is never sent: `dsn_env` names the
environment variable of the API process that holds it. Settings left out keep their
current value (the default for a new Connection).

ConnectionInfo.title: ConnectionInfo
ConnectionInfo.description:
A Connection as listed: whether this process's environment holds its DSN. Never the DSN
or the variable's value.

DeadTupleScan.title: DeadTupleScan
DeadTupleScan.description: A dead-tuple measurement that reads the table (pgstattuple_approx), not the counters.

ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody
ErrorBody.description:
Every error: a stable machine `code`, a `message` to show, and `details` when there is
more to say.

Finding.title: Finding
Finding.description:
A problem or fact about one subject, with an identity stable across Runs.
`unobserved_by` is the latest Run whose scope covered the subject but did not observe the
Finding: it asks the engineer "fixed?". It is never answered automatically.

FindingView.title: FindingView
FindingView.description:
A Finding with what the latest Run to observe it saw: its severity, title, evidence and
recommendation now.

GateLimits.title: GateLimits
GateLimits.description: EXPLAIN gate limits; a statement whose plan exceeds any of them is not run.

Maintenance.title: Maintenance
Maintenance.description:
Activity counters and vacuum/analyze recency of one collection (a partitioned table sums
its leaf partitions and takes the oldest timestamp; None if any leaf never had it).

Observation.title: Observation
Observation.description: What one Run saw for one Finding.

ProbeResult.title: ProbeResult
ProbeResult.description: What the analyzer can see on a Connection.

Run.title: Run
Run.description:
One execution of analyzers against a Connection. `scope` lists, per analyzer, the
collections actually measured; `skipped` those planned but not measured, with the reason.

RunComparison.title: RunComparison

RunIn.title: RunIn
RunIn.description:
A deterministic Run: no model. `collections` targets inventory at those tables
(schema-qualified, or bare when unambiguous) and `exact_counts` counts their rows, each only
where the EXPLAIN gate allows. `min_stats_window_hours` is how young workload statistics
may be before ranking is refused (default 1 h). Options no chosen analyzer takes are
refused.

RunView.title: RunView
RunView.description:
`observations` in rank order, most severe first. `storage` is None when the Run did not
include inventory, else largest first; `workload` is None when it did not include workload.
`skipped` lists whole collections first, then measurements in `storage` order.

Skipped.title: Skipped
Skipped.description:
A collection a Run planned but did not measure (`measurement` None), or one measurement it
did not take on a collection it did measure.

StorageStats.title: StorageStats
StorageStats.description:
Size of one collection. `row_count` is None when the store has no estimate yet.
`skipped` names measurements planned for this collection but not taken, with the reason
(e.g. an exact count the EXPLAIN gate refused); the collection itself was measured.

Thread.title: Thread
Thread.description:
A conversation with the agent, bound to one Connection for its whole life.
`last_active_at` is when its latest Turn started, and `preview` the start of its first
message: both None until its first Turn (and for Threads from before they were kept).

ThreadMessage.title: ThreadMessage
ThreadMessage.description: One message of a Thread's history: the user's, or the agent's final answer.

WorkloadItem.title: WorkloadItem
WorkloadItem.description:
One distinct statement of the workload, ranked. `fingerprint` is a hash of the
normalized text, never the server's query id, so it holds across versions.

WorkloadReport.title: WorkloadReport
WorkloadReport.description:
What the workload part of a Run found. `items` is empty and `refused` says why when the
statistics cannot be ranked; `source` is None when the Connection has none.

Done.description:
Last event of every Turn. `ok` is False when the Turn ended on an Error or was
cancelled; `cancelled` tells the two apart. `answer` is what was answered before it ended.
Done.title: Done

SubagentStarted.description: The orchestrator delegated to a subagent through tool call `call_id`.
SubagentStarted.title: SubagentStarted

HTTPBearer.description: The token `dbx serve` was given, if any.
